foods.name: Fischbrötchen
foods.description: Il panino portuale per eccellenza di Amburgo: pane compatto, pesce affumicato o marinato, cipolla e remoulade. Sembra uno snack semplice, ma racconta il rapporto diretto della città con Elba, Mare del Nord e mercato del pesce, da mangiare in piedi vicino all’acqua.
foods.description_en: Hamburg’s essential harbour sandwich: firm bread, smoked or marinated fish, onion and remoulade. It looks simple, but it tells the city’s direct relationship with the Elbe, the North Sea and the fish market, best eaten standing close to the water.
foods.description_fr: Un petit pain moelleux garni de hareng mariné, de poisson fumé ou de crevettes de la mer du Nord, avec sauce rémoulade, oignons et cornichons. Le sandwich emblématique des marchés portuaires d'Hambourg, vendu sur les quais de l'Elbe depuis des siècles.

foods.description_en: A shipboard dish born from sailors’ cooking: salt beef, potatoes, beetroot, gherkins, egg and often herring. The colour may surprise you, but the flavour is deeply northern: savoury, soft, sweet-sour and made to be nourishing during cold days and long journeys.
